title: Intersection of Multiple Arrays
summary: Given a 2D integer array where each sub-array contains distinct positive integers, return a sorted list of integers that appear in every sub-array.
statement: Given a 2D integer array where each sub-array contains distinct positive integers, return a sorted list of integers that appear in every sub-array.
constraints: Every inner array contains distinct positive integers.
Return values present in every inner array.
The result must be sorted in increasing order and contain no duplicates.
hints: Start with the set of values in the first array.
Intersect it with each later array so only values seen everywhere remain.
Sort the final common set before returning it.
A value survives every intersection exactly when it belongs to every row; sorting satisfies the output contract.
editorial: A value survives every intersection exactly when it belongs to every row; sorting satisfies the output contract.

tests.explanation: Only three and four occur in all three arrays.
The two arrays share no value, so return an empty list.
